waivers.verdict: Hold — nothing clears the bar tonight. Lamar Jackson going from Questionable to Out is an injury update, not a roster move — it doesn't open a spot or change the budget. Thursday's Diggs plan still stands for Monday night.

lineup.verdict: Hold — Kirk Cousins at QB and Bryce Young at SUPER_FLEX already match the best-projected lineup; no further change needed before Sunday.

trades.verdict: Hold — no trade clears the certainty bar this week. The one deal worth a second look (Juwan Johnson for Bhayshul Tuten) actually projects better everywhere, but it opens a brand-new Week 11 TE hole, so it's a pass.

inactives.verdict: Hold — every starter in today's games is tracking active; nothing to flip before kickoff.
